prompt:
Subject: renew, target meaning "更新する".

Composition: A worker replaces worn rubber around a window with a fresh fitted seal, restoring the window's useful condition while the old cracked strip lies nearby.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png only: rounded friendly 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading. Worker removes cracked rubber seal around a window and fits a fresh replacement, restoring its useful condition.
en: The worker renews the worn window seal.
ja: 作業員が窓の古いゴムを新しいものに交換しています。
